en.meta_title: FUE Hair Transplant: Permanent, Natural-Looking Hair Restoration
en.meta_description: Restore a full head of hair with our advanced FUE hair transplant surgery. This minimally invasive technique offers a permanent, natural-looking solution for male and female pattern baldness with no linear scar.
en.meta_keywords: hair transplant, FUE hair transplant, hair restoration, baldness solution, hair loss treatment, Follicular Unit Extraction, hair plugs alternative

what_is.heading: What is a Hair Transplant? A Permanent Solution for Hair Loss
paragraphs: Hair loss can be a distressing experience for both men and women. At LUNAI, we offer a permanent, natural-looking solution with our advanced hair transplant surgery. This procedure involves harvesting healthy, genetically resilient hair follicles from a donor area (typically the back of the scalp) and meticulously implanting them into balding or thinning areas.

procedure.heading: The Advanced FUE Technique
paragraphs: We specialize in the Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) technique, a state-of-the-art method that involves extracting individual follicular units one by one. This approach avoids the linear scar associated with older methods and allows for a faster, more comfortable recovery. Our experienced team uses artistic precision to place each graft at the correct angle and density to mimic natural hair growth patterns.

candidates_results.heading: Candidates and Expected Results
paragraphs: Hair transplantation is a viable solution for male and female pattern baldness. The transplanted hair will shed in the first few weeks, which is normal. New, permanent hair will begin to grow in 3-4 months, with the final, full results visible after about 12-18 months. Reclaim a full head of hair and your confidence with a LUNAI hair transplant.
